description: This Java class 'CreateOfficeCommandHandler' acts as a command handler for creating an office entity within the Fineract platform. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates the creation process to the 'OfficeWritePlatformService'. The class is annotated with Spring's @Service and a custom @CommandType annotation, indicating its role and the type of command it handles.

classes.name: CreateOfficeCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service component that handles creation commands for offices by delegating to the OfficeWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the creation command by invoking the 'createOffice' method on the write platform service.
